Name: Just a Little More to Do
Author: appleschloss
Description:
I made this mod as a way to have a Vanilla+ experience in my Stardew Valley saves. I love adding more to my game, but never so much that I get overwhelmed. When I couldn't find a mod that just added a handful more fish and gems, I decided to make one myself!

I have *no idea* if this is compatible with SVE as I made this primarily for people who find SVE daunting but still want some more content in their game. (That doesn't mean it isn't compatible, I just didn't test it myself! Some of the fish do overlap with ones added by SVE but most of them are different)

Currently I know this works with:
* Lookup Anything
* Visual Fish

What this mod adds:
* 10 new fish
* 1 new ocean crabpot fish
* 4 new gems/minerals
* 2 new artifacts

(aka enough to fill the remaining spots in a vanilla museum!)

Things I know the mod is missing:
* Aquarium compatibility (they don't have aquarium sprites yet)

If you're looking for that Vanilla+ experience, here are some other mods I highly recommend!
* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23253]Hidden Crops Recipes[/url] (adds recipes for each of the new seasonal crops!)
* [url=http:///www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25541]Berry Woods[/url] (adds a new section of the Secret Woods for resource gathering and monster hunting!)

Now if you want the full Deets about the items added- check below!
